interpretation: Scoped follow-up on one screened sustained fault family per layer; not a family-transfer or full #183 confirmation
sample: 10 verified fault losses per layer and 10 no-injection losses, one game per seed; exclude all seeds from the prior rapid and blind freezes
unit: one complete game and one cause label
probe_rule: Repeat every recorded decision at its saved raw state through the pinned clean checkpoint and reference Tank War path; report only neutral comparisons
primary_measure: correct game-level component among 30 machine-verified fault losses; uncertain counts as incorrect
paired_comparison: probe minus read accuracy on the same 30 games; class-stratified paired bootstrap with 10000 draws and RNG seed 183
scoped_go_rule: probe-minus-read 95% interval lower bound greater than zero, probe accuracy greater than the 10/30 majority baseline, and no invalid or leaked diagnosis
controls: Report unsupported harness/controller calls on 10 unmodified losses; a weights answer is not automatically false
model_input: anonymous replay and neutral controlled repeats only; no manifest, seed, fault layer, technical reference, or gold answer
analysis_limits: The harness strategy setting also participates in plan revalidation after model choice.
One sustained fault family per layer does not test transfer to unseen families.
The old episode-only prompt was developed on earlier games but these selected seeds have not been used in the prior rapid or blind tests.
A verified local layer effect does not prove the intervention caused the whole-game loss.
